messages.author: 95e9261d3e867527
messages.subject: installing rexpokit on linux
parts:
Hi Nick,

I am trying to install the BGB dependency rexpokit on a linux machine (centos). Both gcc and gfortran are installed. I am getting the following error message:

> library(remotes)
> install_github("nmatzke/rexpokit", INSTALL_opts="--byte-compile")

Running `R CMD build`...
* checking for file ‘/tmp/Rtmp4angC3/remotes1cf3b19797552/nmatzke-rexpokit-2e7712f/DESCRIPTION’ ... OK
* preparing ‘rexpokit’:
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... OK
* cleaning src
* running ‘cleanup’
* checking for LF line-endings in source and make files and shell scripts
* checking for empty or unneeded directories
* building ‘rexpokit_0.26.6.7.tar.gz’
Installing package into ‘/home/joelnitta/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.6’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
* installing *source* package ‘rexpokit’ ...
** using staged installation
** libs
gfortran -m64  -fpic  -O2 -g -pipe -Wall -Wp,-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fexceptions -fstack-protector-strong --param=ssp-buffer-size=4 -grecord-gcc-switches   -m64 -mtune=generic -I/usr/lib64/gfortran/modules  -c lapack/blas_mod.f -o lapack/blas_mod.o
lapack/blas_mod.f:979:24:

  979 |       if(incy.lt.0)iy = (-m+1)*incy + 1
      |                        1
Warning: Possible change of value in conversion from COMPLEX(8) to INTEGER(4) at (1) [-Wconversion]
{standard input}: Assembler messages:
{standard input}:11: Error: unknown .loc sub-directive `view'

... this continues for 8000 lines of {standard input}:XX: Error...

ending in

make: *** [lapack/blas_mod.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘rexpokit’
* removing ‘/home/joelnitta/R/x86_64-redhat-linux-gnu-library/3.6/rexpokit’
Error: Failed to install 'rexpokit' from GitHub:
  (converted from warning) installation of package ‘/tmp/Rtmp4angC3/file1cf3b73dae11b/rexpokit_0.26.6.7.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status
In addition: Warning message:
In missing_devel_warning(pkgdir) :
  Package rexpokit has compiled code, but no suitable compiler(s) were found. Installation will likely fail.
  Install compilers via your Linux package manager.

I get a similar error message if I install from CRAN with install.packages()

I noticed on the old wiki you had some code for installing rexpokit (http://phylo.wikidot.com/rexpokit#fortran_update_2017)

I couldn't quite figure it out from that, but is there a recommended way for installing this when the binary isn't available?

Thanks!

- Joel
